title: Bose's paper published under Einstein's endorsement

tellings.quote: >> and he sent one to Albert Einstein said, "Nobody's listening to me."

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he once saw a UFO in a secret hangar, tells a story from physics in the 1920s. He says the Indian scientist Satyendra Nath Bose could not get anyone to listen to his paper, so he sent it to Albert Einstein, the famous physicist, saying nobody was listening to him, and it was then published with Einstein's backing. Rogers tells it to show how new ideas can be ignored until a famous name vouches for them.
